records.name: 23, ASHWELL LANE
records.details:
YELVERTOFT ASHWELL LANE SP57NE (North side) 6/199 No.23

- II

House. Probably late C17. Part timber frame with brick infill panels and corrugated metal roof. 2-unit plan. Single-storey with attic; 2-window range of casements. Central plank door with narrow roof dormer above. Small window with leaded lights to right of door below eaves. Brick stack at ridge. Gable walls rebuilt in brick. Interior not inspected.

records.name: 10, ELKINGTON ROAD
records.details:
YELVERTOFT ELKINGTON ROAD SP57NE (South side) 6/200 No. 10

GV II

House. Late C17. Timber frame with small framing on a lias plinth; brick infill and corrugated metal roof. Originally 2-unit plan. Single storey with attic, 2-window range at ground floor of casements. Brick stacks at ends. Single storey extension to right probably late C18. Left gable and rear similar with exposed timber frame having some arched and tension bracing. Interior not inspected.

Plank doors to right and to left side elevation. Brick stack at ridge. Side and rear elevations similar with some arched and tension bracing. Interior not inspected.

records.name: THE OLD GABLE
records.details:
YELVERTOFT HIGH STREET SP57NE (West side) 6/208 The Old Gable

GV II

House. Late C17, C18 and C19. Lias, brick and timber frame with small framing on lias plinth with brick infill and corrugated metal roof. Originally probably 2-unit plan with cross-wing to the right. 2 storeys. Right gable of one-window range of casements has exposed timber frame. Canted bay to left on ground floor. Brick stacks at ridges. Single-storey one-window range extension to left. Elevation to right has exposed timber-frame with brick infill. Interior not inspected.

records.details:
SP67NW
7/209

YELVERTOFT
HIGH STREET
(West side)
No.88 (The Stone House)

GV
II

House. Early C18, remodelled C19. Squared coursed lias with plain-tile roof.
3-unit plan. 2 storeys; 3-window range of casements. C19 four-panelled door and
hood to left of centre has evidence of a blocked door immediately to the left.
Ashlar gable parapet and kneelers and brick stacks at ridge and end. Room to
left of entrance has one large moulded ceiling beam.

records.name: BARBERRY FARMHOUSE
records.details:
SP57NE
6/210

YELVERTOFT
KINGS LANE
(North side)
Barberry Farmhouse

II

Farmhouse, now house. Probably early C18. Squared coursed lias with C20 slate
roof. 3-unit plan. 2 storeys with attic; 3-window range of C19 tripartite sashes
at first floor and casements and one sash at ground floor, all under wood
lintels. Plank door to right of centre has C19 reeded wood surround. Remains of
ashlar kneelers. C20 dormers, brick stacks at ridge and end. Attic window with
stone surround in right gable. Interior has 2 open fireplaces; room to left of
entrance has stopped chamfered ceiling beam. Dogleg staircase has late C17
turned balusters, probably reset.

Listing NGR: SP5956775526

records.name: Blyth House
records.details:
SP57NE
6/212

YELVERTOFT
SWINNERTONS LANE (north side)
Blyth House

II

Farmhouse, now house. Mid C18. Painted brick with ashlar dressings and slate roof. Three-unit plan. Two storeys with attic; five-window range of C20 casements in original openings under flat brick arches. Double-panel folding plank door to left of centre has large strap hinges and fanlight over with glazing bars. Rusticated ashlar quoins, flat string course between storeys and moulded stone cornice. Ashlar gable parapets and kneelers, and brick stacks at ridge and ends. Left gable has weathered ashlar tablet with cornice.

Interior: room to right of entrance has moulded ceiling beams; room to far right has remains of open fireplace.

records.name: WAR MEMORIAL AT JUNCTION OF SWINNERTONS LANE AND HIGH STREET
records.officialName: War Memorial at Junction of Swinnertons Lane and High Street
records.details:
SP57NE
6/213

YELVERTOFT
SWINNERTONS LANE
War memorial at junction of Swinnertons Lane and High Street

GV
II

War memorial. Early C20. Limestone ashlar. Octagonal shaft on square plinth with
base of 3 octagonal steps. The capital is gabled and foliated, with crocket
decoration and figures in mitres. Inscriptions on plinth commemorate the dead of
the First and Second World Wars.

Listing NGR: SP5972675536

records.name: CHURCH OF ALL SAINTS
records.details:
YELVERTOFT WEST HADDON ROAD SP67NW (East side) 7/217 Church of All Saints 18/01/68

- I

Church. C13 and C14, restored C19. Regular coursed and ashlar lias with lead roofs. Aisled nave with double south aisle; chancel and west tower. Chancel: South elevation of 2-window range of 2- and 3-light windows, that to left is C19. South chapel projection has one C19, three-light square-headed window to the south and one 3-light west window with segmental arch head. Chancel north elevation of one-window range of a 3-light Perpendicular window flanked by slender buttresses. The buttresses and wall below the window are extensively decorated with cusps, quatrefoils and shields. East window of chancel of 3-lights with Reticulated tracery. Outer south aisle of 3-window range of 3-light windows; that to far left has a square head, the other have segmental heads. Gabled roof with ashlar gable parapets. South porch has ogee-headed outer arch with 3 orders of ball flowers and fleurons. West elevation of south aisles of 2-window range of 3-light windows that to left has a concave soffit and square head. North aisle of 3-window range of 3-light windows with plain segmental heads. North door to right of centre has double chamfered arch. North chapel of one-window range of a C19 three-light square-headed window to north and 2-light window to east. Nave clerestory of 4-window range of 2-light windows with one 4-light window to east of north elevation. Gabled roof with ashlar parapets. West tower of 4 stages with clasping buttresses to western angles of lower 3 stages. 2-light Perpendicular window in west face of second stage has niche above in third stage. 2-light Perpendicular bell-chamber openings in fourth stage have transoms with cusping. Castellated parapet above. Interior: Double-chamfered arches with octagonal piers. Triple-chamfered tower arch. The chancel has a flat plastered ceiling and the nave has a shallow C19 roof with plastered underside. Sedilia to south of chancel has nodding ogee arches. Monument to John Dycson, rector from 1439 to 1445. Alabaster effigy on low tomb chest decorated with quatrefoils, low segmental arch over with flanking buttresses decorated with small niches. This monument corresponds internally with the external display of Perpendicular decoration. Thomas Rumpin, died 1770, by William Cox senior to left of south chapel arch; marble tablet with cherub below and armorial device above. Thomas Wills, died 1774, in south chapel; marble tablet with curved sides. John Watkin, died 1772, in the chancel; oval tablet with armorial device above. Various other C19 marble tablets. Bench ends probably C16 carved with Gothic tracery. (Buildings of England: Northamptonshire, p.472).

records.name: THE OLD RECTORY
records.details:
SP67NW YELVERTOFT WEST HADDON ROAD 7/218 (East side) The Old Rectory - II

Rectory, now house. Early C19. Brick with slate roof. Double-depth plan. 2 storeys with mezzanine level. Garden front of 5-window range of sashes with glazing bars under stone wedge lintels. Shallow gable to right.Shallow pitched roof, brick stacks at ridge and end. Entrance front is similar of two-window range with gable to right and half-glazed double doors in moulded wood surround to right. Interior has staircase with stick balusters with quarters landings around a well. Hall and landing have various segmental arches.

records.name: 12, ELKINGTON ROAD
records.details:
YELVERTOFT ELKINGTON ROAD SP57NE (South side) 6/201 No.12

GV II

House. Late C17 and C19. Timber-frame with small framing on lias plinth; brick infill and corrugated metal roof. 3-unit plan. Single-storey with attic. 3-window range of casements at ground floor. C19 plank door to right of centre. The sections of wall to the left and right of the centre have been rebuilt in brickwork, however the timber frame may remain under the section to the right. Brick stacks at ridge and end. C19 and C20 extensions to left. Interior not inspected but noted as having chamfered ceiling beams.

records.details:
YELVERTOFT HIGH STREET SP57NE (East side) 6/203 Tudor Cottage

Brick stack at ridge to rear. Rear and sides similar. C20 entrance to right side. Interior not inspected but noted as having some chamfered beams.

Listing NGR: SP5957775621

records.details:

Single storey with attic; 2-window range of C19 casements at ground floor with door between. Dormer to right. Brick stack at ridge. Rear similar but partially rebuilt in stone. records.name: THE MANOR HOUSE
records.details:
SP67NW
7/204

YELVERTOFT
HIGH STREET
(East side)
The Manor House

II

Manor house. Mid C17 to C20. Squared coursed lias and brick, some chequer
patterned; with a slate roof. Originally probably E-plan now indeterminate.
Entrance front of 5-window range. The 2 bays to the far left are C17, lias, with
the centre breaking forward, originally as a porch, 6-light stone mullion window
with transom to ground floor left and 2 three-light stone mullion windows to
first floor. Ashlar gable parapets and kneelers. 3 window range to right is
probably late C18, chequered brickwork, with 6-light C19 stone mullion window to
far right, centre C20 door with C19 moulded stone surround and hood. C19 dormers
to first floor. Tall brick stacks at ridge and end. Interior remodelled early
C20. The original C17 and C18 house was partially remodelled in 1893 and reduced
in size in the 1950's.

records.name: Yelvertoft Independent Chapel
records.details:
This list entry was subject to a Minor Amendment on 10 June 2026 to amend the name and address and reformat the text to current standards

SP57NE
6/207

YELVERTOFT
HIGH STREET (West side)
Yelvertoft Independent Chapel

(Formerly listed as Congregational Church)

II
Congregational Church. c.1792, refronted 1832. Brick with slate roof. Single unit chapel with vestibule and gallery. Entrance front has late C19 brick porch flanked by two arch headed windows with glazing bars, two Diocletian windows at first floor with circular window between. Plain gable above. Late C19 extension to left. Side elevations have windows with arch heads and glazing bars. Interior not inspected.

(Yelvertoft by Yelvertoft Womens Institute).

records.name: THE OLD HOUSE
records.details:
YELVERTOFT SCHOOL LANE SP57NE (South side) 6/211 The Old House 18/10/85 - II

House. Probably early C16, datestone 1687. Squared coursed lias, timber frame with brick and cob infill panels and corrugated metal roof. T-shape plan. 2 storeys, 2-window range. Stone cross-wing to left with timber-framed wing at right angles. C19 casement windows to left. C19 canted bay-window to cross wing has 3-light stone mullion above. C20 door to left of centre has C19 moulded wood surround. Ashlar gable parapets to cross wing and brick stacks to ridge and laterally to cross wing. Datestone on cross wing. Right gable rebuilt in brick. Interior not inspected but noted as having open fireplace and chamfered ceiling beams.

Listing NGR: SP5960775673

records.name: YEW TREE FARMHOUSE
records.details:
YELVERTOFT WARDS LANE SP67NW (North side) 7/214 Yew Tree Farmhouse

- II

Farmhouse. Mid C18. Squared coursed lias with corrugated metal roof. L-shape plan with cross wing to left projecting at rear. 2 storeys. Entrance front of 2-window range at ground floor and one-window range at first floor of C19 casements with glazing bars, all under wood lintels. 6-panelled door with moulded wood doorcase between windows. Ashlar gable parapets and kneelers, and brick stacks at ridge and end. Elevation to left similar 2-window range. The two wings would appear to be of different dates. Interior not inspected.
